required_tool_recall: A supported tool case passes if every required group has at least one retrieved capability; report initial and rediscovered menus separately. Denied providers are routing-only fixtures, never live executions.
simple_task_success: Live cases only: all required groups executed successfully, result data passes independent finite/bounds/schema predicates, returned answer contains corresponding measured evidence and no unsupported success claims. Failures remain in denominator.
brevity: At most three complete sentences, each <=35 words, unless detail explicitly requested. Sentence segmentation ignores decimals and abbreviations. No truncation of failed cases from denominator.
responsiveness: P50/P95 interpolated milliseconds per scope, routing, observable local lease wait, server queue (null unless measured), first model content, tool, verification, first useful visible sentence, total, chars/words/sentences. Owner speech to acoustic onset is NOT TESTED unless measured with physical audio.
hardware: Record actual local model identity, props, configured settings and psutil hardware; no remote services or model downloads.
no_tuning: Freeze this file and heldout.json SHA256 before implementation. Do not modify either file or tune implementation against heldout evaluation failures.
